name: co.datacandy/leads
title: Data Candy: US business leads
description: Count, preview and quote US business leads for free, then buy them with a spending limit.

tools.name: database_overview
tools.description: Overview of the Data Candy US business-lead database: how many records it holds, how many have an email, a mobile number or a website, how fresh the data is, the fields on each lead, and the current prices and payment options. Free, no account needed.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: List the industries you can filter on, with lead counts. Pass `search` (for example "roof") to also find the more specific categories such as "Roofing contractor". Use the exact names it returns in the industry and category filters. Free.

search.description: Find industries and more specific categories containing this text, e.g. "roof".

limit.description: Maximum categories to return with search (default 25).

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List US states with lead counts, or the cities of one state (pass `state`, optionally `search` to narrow by name). Use the exact values in the state and city filters. Free.

state.description: 2-letter state code: list the cities of this state.

search.description: Only cities whose name contains this text.

tools.name: count_leads
tools.description: Count the leads that match the filters (industry, category, keyword, state, city, ZIP, has_email, has_cell and so on). Fast and free; nothing is charged. Returns the count and whether it is exact.

industry.description: Exact industry name from list_industries, e.g. "Construction & Contractors".

category.description: Specific category, e.g. "Roofing contractor" (find names with list_industries and its search argument).

state.description: 2-letter US state code, or a comma-separated list such as "TX,OK".

city.description: Exact city name (case-insensitive). Use together with state.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code, or a comma-separated list of ZIP codes.

has_email.description: Only leads that have an email address.

has_cell.description: Only leads that have a mobile phone number.

has_phone.description: Only leads that have any phone number.

has_website.description: Only leads that have a website.

has_facebook.description: Only leads that have a Facebook page.

has_owner_name.description: Only leads that have the owner's name.

filters.description: Search filters, all optional. Combine as needed; more filters means fewer leads.

tools.name: preview_leads
tools.description: Show up to 10 sample leads for the filters with email, phone and last name partly hidden, plus the total number of matches. Free; use it to check the filters return the kind of businesses you want.

industry.description: Exact industry name from list_industries, e.g. "Construction & Contractors".

category.description: Specific category, e.g. "Roofing contractor" (find names with list_industries and its search argument).

state.description: 2-letter US state code, or a comma-separated list such as "TX,OK".

city.description: Exact city name (case-insensitive). Use together with state.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code, or a comma-separated list of ZIP codes.

has_email.description: Only leads that have an email address.

has_cell.description: Only leads that have a mobile phone number.

has_phone.description: Only leads that have any phone number.

has_website.description: Only leads that have a website.

has_facebook.description: Only leads that have a Facebook page.

has_owner_name.description: Only leads that have the owner's name.

filters.description: Search filters, all optional. Combine as needed; more filters means fewer leads.

limit.description: How many sample rows (1 to 10, default 5).

tools.name: quote_leads
tools.description: Exact price for buying `quantity` leads for the filters. Nothing is charged. Returns how many leads match, the price in dollars and the payment methods available right now.

industry.description: Exact industry name from list_industries, e.g. "Construction & Contractors".

category.description: Specific category, e.g. "Roofing contractor" (find names with list_industries and its search argument).

state.description: 2-letter US state code, or a comma-separated list such as "TX,OK".

city.description: Exact city name (case-insensitive). Use together with state.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code, or a comma-separated list of ZIP codes.

has_email.description: Only leads that have an email address.

has_cell.description: Only leads that have a mobile phone number.

has_phone.description: Only leads that have any phone number.

has_website.description: Only leads that have a website.

has_facebook.description: Only leads that have a Facebook page.

has_owner_name.description: Only leads that have the owner's name.

filters.description: Search filters, all optional. Combine as needed; more filters means fewer leads.

quantity.description: How many leads (1 to 25,000). If fewer match, you get what matches.

after_id.description: Continue after this lead id (use next_after_id from an earlier order to get new leads).

tools.name: buy_leads
tools.description: Buy leads. THIS SPENDS MONEY AND CANNOT BE UNDONE. max_price_usd is required: nothing is bought if the price is higher. Paid from the account's credits (API key needed) it returns the leads at once: the first 25 inline and download links for the full set. Otherwise it returns a checkout link and an order id; a person pays on that page, then get_order returns the leads. Run quote_leads first.

industry.description: Exact industry name from list_industries, e.g. "Construction & Contractors".

category.description: Specific category, e.g. "Roofing contractor" (find names with list_industries and its search argument).

state.description: 2-letter US state code, or a comma-separated list such as "TX,OK".

city.description: Exact city name (case-insensitive). Use together with state.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code, or a comma-separated list of ZIP codes.

has_email.description: Only leads that have an email address.

has_cell.description: Only leads that have a mobile phone number.

has_phone.description: Only leads that have any phone number.

has_website.description: Only leads that have a website.

has_facebook.description: Only leads that have a Facebook page.

has_owner_name.description: Only leads that have the owner's name.

filters.description: Search filters, all optional. Combine as needed; more filters means fewer leads.

quantity.description: How many leads (1 to 25,000). If fewer match, you get what matches.

max_price_usd.description: REQUIRED spending cap in US dollars. Nothing is bought if the price is higher.

after_id.description: Continue after this lead id (use next_after_id from an earlier order to get new leads).

fresh.description: Skip leads this account already received for the same search (default true when an API key is used).

payment_method.description: auto (default): account credits when enough, else a Shared Payment Token if given, else a checkout link. checkout: always return a link for a person to pay.

shared_payment_token.description: Stripe Shared Payment Token (spt_...), only with payment_method "stripe_spt".

email.description: Email for the receipt and for recovering the order.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same value when retrying after a timeout so you are never charged twice for one purchase.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Check an order by its id: status (awaiting_payment, paid, fulfilled, expired ...), price and, once fulfilled, the first 25 leads plus download links for the whole set. Use it after a person has paid a checkout link. Nothing is charged.

order_id.description: The order id returned by buy_leads, like "ord_...". Keep it secret: it grants the download.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Show the account behind your API key: email, plan, credit balance, today's usage and spend limits. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer dc_live_... or X-API-Key).

tools.name: add_credits
tools.description: Start a credit top-up of $10 to $1,000. THIS SPENDS MONEY once a person pays. Returns a Stripe checkout link that a person must open; the credits arrive after payment and buy_leads then spends them. Needs an API key.

amount_usd.description: Top-up amount in US dollars, 10 to 1000.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same value when retrying after a timeout so you are never charged twice for one purchase.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a Data Candy account and API key for an email address (free; credits start at $0). The key is shown once: store it. Returns the exact MCP configuration to reconnect with the key. If the email already has an account, no key is returned and its owner gets a sign-in link by email.

email.description: Email address that will own the account.

agent_name.description: Name of your agent or app.

use_case.description: What you will use the leads for.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same value when retrying after a timeout so you are never charged twice for one purchase.

tools.name: get_free_sample
tools.description: Email 25 free real sample leads to an address (use the person's own email). This sends a real email. No text message is sent from here.

email.description: Where to email the sample: the person's own address.

name.description: Name of the person asking for the sample.

phone.description: Ignored: no text message is sent from this tool.
